title: Glowing crescent moon
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <defs>
    <radialGradient id='glow' cx='50%' cy='50%' r='50%'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#FFF9C4' stop-opacity='0.6'/>
      <stop offset='60%' stop-color='#FFE082' stop-opacity='0.2'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#FFE082' stop-opacity='0'/>
    </radialGradient>
    <radialGradient id='moonGrad' cx='40%' cy='40%' r='60%'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#FFFDE7'/>
      <stop offset='50%' stop-color='#FFEB3B'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#FFC107'/>
    </radialGradient>
    <radialGradient id='outlineGlow' cx='50%' cy='50%' r='50%'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#FFD54F' stop-opacity='0.9'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#FFAB00' stop-opacity='0.5'/>
    </radialGradient>
  </defs>

  <!-- Outer glow -->
  <circle cx='48' cy='50' r='42' fill='url(#glow)'/>

  <!-- Crescent moon shape using a path mask via layered circles -->
  <!-- Glow ring behind moon -->
  <circle cx='46' cy='48' r='30' fill='none' stroke='url(#outlineGlow)' stroke-width='6' opacity='0.5'/>

  <!-- Main crescent: big circle minus offset circle creates crescent -->
  <!-- Outer circle of crescent -->
  <circle cx='46' cy='48' r='28' fill='url(#moonGrad)'/>

  <!-- Inner shadow circle to carve crescent (dark but lit in deep amber) -->
  <circle cx='58' cy='40' r='22' fill='#1A1A2E'/>

  <!-- To make it look lit not pure black, overlay a deep purple inner glow on the dark cutout -->
  <circle cx='58' cy='40' r='22' fill='none' stroke='#2E1B4A' stroke-width='3' opacity='0.7'/>

  <!-- Soft inner highlight on moon's lit edge -->
  <circle cx='42' cy='44' r='24' fill='none' stroke='#FFFFFF' stroke-width='2' opacity='0.35'/>

  <!-- Tiny sparkle stars -->
  <circle cx='24' cy='28' r='2.5' fill='#FFF9C4'/>
  <circle cx='24' cy='28' r='1.2' fill='#FFFFFF'/>

  <circle cx='72' cy='22' r='2' fill='#FFF9C4'/>
  <circle cx='72' cy='22' r='0.9' fill='#FFFFFF'/>

  <circle cx='30' cy='70' r='1.8' fill='#FFF9C4'/>
  <circle cx='30' cy='70' r='0.8' fill='#FFFFFF'/>

  <circle cx='78' cy='62' r='2.2' fill='#FFF9C4'/>
  <circle cx='78' cy='62' r='1' fill='#FFFFFF'/>

  <circle cx='65' cy='78' r='1.5' fill='#FFF9C4'/>
  <circle cx='65' cy='78' r='0.7' fill='#FFFFFF'/>

  <circle cx='18' cy='50' r='1.5' fill='#FFF9C4'/>
  <circle cx='18' cy='50' r='0.7' fill='#FFFFFF'/>

  <circle cx='82' cy='42' r='1.5' fill='#FFF9C4'/>
  <circle cx='82' cy='42' r='0.7' fill='#FFFFFF'/>
</svg>
